tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind every card. A cool grey in light, a blue-black in dark. Settings → Appearance offers six page tones, each a value of `canvas`, and this one is the default. Never a card's own fill.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, document tiles, popovers, dialogs, toasts, the sidebar and inputs. A card stands off `canvas` by this fill and `shadow-card`, never by an outline.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a card: the neutral chip (tags, projects, matters, a document's type, a finished state), a tile's thumbnail ground, the question in Ask, a progress track, hover on a row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines only: between table rows, between summary-list rows, and the sidebar's edge. Decorative, so it needs no 3:1. Never a control's border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The edge of every control: inputs, selects, outline buttons, filter chips, checkboxes and the upload drop zone. At least 3:1 on `canvas`, `panel` and `tile`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `canvas`, `panel` and `tile`: a document's title on its tile, every amount on a document, and a finished state's check icon.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill. Kept at Family Finances' value so the two systems stay one; Library has no `ink`-filled surface today.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text at 13px or larger: a tile's sender and date, summary-list labels, table headers, hints, captions and a page's lede. On `panel`, `tile` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Something failed: a failed job or upload, a document that did not process, a form error. Always with an alert icon and words, on `panel` or `deficit-tint`. The same red as `deficit`, so never decoration.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The value of the focus ring where one colour is needed. The app draws the ring in `currentColor` instead: the colour of the control's own text, which contrasts with what it sits on, including a violet button.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Violet chrome: links, the active filter chip's edge, a citation's number in Ask. Means 'this can be acted on'. Never a state, never a document type, never decoration.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: The primary button, a checked checkbox, a switch that is on, and the app icon's square. The one accent that does not flip between themes, so white stays legible on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-fill`, including the app icon's mark.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item, an active filter chip and the current page in pagination.

tokens.name: brand-on-tint
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-tint`: the active sidebar item, an active filter chip's value, the current page's number.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: Violet marks that carry no text: the fill of an upload's or a job's progress bar, on a `tile` track. Never text, and never a label's ground.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Money in, in the spending and payments views only: a refund, a positive net. Never on a document tile, never a finished state, never a tag.

tokens.name: income-tint
tokens.usage: The ground under `income` text: a refund's chip in the payments view.

tokens.name: deficit
tokens.usage: A negative net, in the spending and payments views only. An ordinary amount on a document is `ink`, not red.

tokens.name: deficit-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a failed state: the Failed chip and the error banner, under `error-ink`. In the spending views, the ground of a negative net's chip under `deficit`.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: The owner has something to do: Needs review, held emails, a job waiting on input. The to-do strip's label and the Needs review chip, on `attention-tint`.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: The to-do strip and the Needs review chip.

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Money in, as a mark in a spending or payments chart: a refund drawn below the zero line. Never text.

tokens.name: chart-spending
tokens.usage: Spending, as a mark in a chart that has no split. Never text.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. A reference mark, deliberately below 3:1 so it never shouts over the data. The zero line is `control-border`.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: A mark for 'nothing here' that should be present at a glance without alerting: a month with no documents in a chart. Below 3:1 on purpose, so it never reads as data.

tokens.name: category-1
tokens.usage: The first series hue in a chart, and the Letter type's default colour: the 4px band across the top of its tile. The same in both themes. A colour the owner picked for a type or a split value wins over the default.

tokens.name: category-2
tokens.usage: The second series hue (teal), and the Receipt type's default band. See `category-1`.

tokens.name: category-3
tokens.usage: The third series hue (blue), and the Invoice type's default band. See `category-1`.

tokens.name: category-4
tokens.usage: The fourth series hue (amber), and the Warranty type's default band. Brighter than `attention` on purpose, so a warranty's band never reads as Needs review.

tokens.name: category-5
tokens.usage: The fifth series hue (fuchsia), and the Contract type's default band. See `category-1`.

tokens.name: category-other
tokens.usage: 'Other (N)', the folded tail of a split chart. Recessive on purpose: the same values are named in the legend.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: A lead figure, at most one per screen: a chart's total on its own page. Tabular figures. Below 640px wide, 36px/40px.

styles.name: type-title-1
styles.usage: The page title in the header. One per screen.

styles.name: type-figure
styles.usage: A total in a chart's card or a payment group's header. Tabular figures. 16px on a phone.

styles.name: type-title-2
styles.usage: A card's title, a dialog's and an empty state's.

styles.name: type-lead
styles.sample: Basic cover plus dental from 1 Jan 2027. The monthly premium rises by €6.40.
styles.usage: A page's lede under its title, and a document's summary in its Summary card, in `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: type-body
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, menu items, inputs and an Ask answer. On a touch screen, fields take 16px: iOS zooms the page into any field under 16px when it is focused.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Field labels, filter chips, buttons, table headers and the labels in a summary list. Sentence case, never uppercase: this replaces the old uppercase `.filter-label`.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: A tile's sender and date line, hints and secondary lines, in `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: type-small
styles.usage: A chip's text, a comment's date, a citation's page. The smallest text in the app; never smaller, so today's 10px history labels move up to it.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Strings copied character by character or written by a machine: file names, checksums, API keys, job ids, tool names in Ask. Never figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a tile's lines; a compact card's padding on a phone; the gap between tiles on a phone.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The side gutter on a phone; a tile's padding; the gap between cards on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A card's padding on desktop (20px by 22px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The gap between cards and between document tiles on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The page's side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above an empty state's message.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, the sidebar's items, a citation row.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, document tiles, the to-do strip, banners and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, drawers and the question bubble in Ask.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips, tag chips, the switch and progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and document tile in light. None in dark, where `panel` is lighter than `canvas` and that is enough.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, toasts and the phone's sidebar drawer, which float over the page.
